title: Traffic Systems Skills
hook: Every stuck service business is short on one of three things. Usually not the one they're working on.
statement: Diagnose any service business by asking whether traffic, systems, or skills are holding growth back.
explainer: Great skills with no traffic keeps you invisible. Traffic with weak systems leaks opportunities. Systems with weak skills disappoints clients. Find the weak leg and stop guessing.
sop: Fix that one before polishing the other two.
equation_example: Traffic 8, Systems 3, Skills 9. 8 × 3 × 9 = 216 Business Strength. Now all three at 7: 7 × 7 × 7 = 343. Higher, because multiplying punishes the weak link. One low score drags everything down, no matter how strong the rest are.
question: Write down whether your bottleneck right now is traffic, systems, or skills, plus one fix for it.
closing_statement: Your weakest leg sets the ceiling for everything else.
